transformation_rule: PROPOSAL (held pending sign-off, D-019): Fuse planned cruise calls with empirical Greek NAP inbound ferry passenger/vehicle daily baselines across 6 EL62 ports via `scripts/verification/compute-data07-anticipated-congestion.py`. refined_data.title: Scheduled port traffic (EL62) — master timetable for Data07 anticipated congestion
refined_data.method: S(P,D) = min(1, w_berth*N_ships/B_max + w_pax*(L_cruise+L_ferry_pax)/C_pax + w_veh*L_ferry_veh/C_veh); level low<0.50, medium<0.85, high>=0.85 (research-notes 2026-10-15 §4).
